part.text: No track-specific files exist, so I'll implement the game logic in a functional style (pure helper functions + state) without external dependencies.
One correction — the win-on-last-guess test requires the game to remain ongoing at 0 remaining guesses (it ends only after the 10th failure):

files.patch:
Index: hangman.py
===================================================================
--- hangman.py
+++ hangman.py
@@ -13,9 +13,9 @@
 
 def _status(word, guessed, remaining_guesses):
     if all(c in guessed for c in word):
         return STATUS_WIN
-    if remaining_guesses == 0:
+    if remaining_guesses < 0:
         return STATUS_LOSE
     return STATUS_ONGOING
